class.name: VECSEntity
class.brief_description:
A lightweight, garbage-collected handle to an ECS entity.
一个轻量的、由垃圾回收的 ECS 实体句柄。
class.description:
[b]VECSEntity[/b] wraps a 64-bit entity id (slot + generation) and gives GDScript access to the entity's components. Handles are transient: validity is checked against the owning world on every access, so a stale handle (from a destroyed or recycled entity) reports [method is_alive] as [code]false[/code] instead of corrupting data.
Obtain handles from [method VECSWorld.create_entity], [method VECSWorld.spawn], [method VECSWorld.spawn_from_data] or query results. Use [method get_component] to get a [VECSComponent] field accessor, or the convenience [method getf] / [method setf] for one-call field access.
[b]VECSEntity[/b] 包装一个 64 位实体 id（槽位 + 代数），为 GDScript 提供访问实体组件的入口。句柄是临时的：每次访问都会对照所属世界校验有效性，因此过期句柄（来自已销毁或已回收的实体）的 [method is_alive] 会返回 [code]false[/code]，而不是破坏数据。
句柄来自 [method VECSWorld.create_entity]、[method VECSWorld.spawn]、[method VECSWorld.spawn_from_data] 或查询结果。用 [method get_component] 获取 [VECSComponent] 字段访问器，或用便捷方法 [method getf] / [method setf] 一次调用读写字段。

method.name: add_component
method.description:
Adds a component of type [param type_name] to this entity, initializing its fields from [param fields] (absent fields default to zero). Issuing this inside an iteration is an error; use [method VECSCommandBuffer.add_component] to defer it.
向该实体添加 [param type_name] 类型的组件，用 [param fields] 初始化字段（缺失字段默认归零）。在迭代内调用会报错；请用 [method VECSCommandBuffer.add_component] 延迟执行。

method.name: equals
method.description:
Returns [code]true[/code] if [param other] refers to the same entity id.
若 [param other] 指向同一实体 id 则返回 [code]true[/code]。

method.name: get_component
method.description:
Returns a [VECSComponent] accessor for the component [param type_name], or a null handle if this entity does not have it (or is dead).
返回组件 [param type_name] 的 [VECSComponent] 访问器；若该实体没有此组件（或已销毁）则返回空句柄。

method.name: get_component_types
method.description:
Returns the names of every component currently attached to this entity.
返回当前挂载在该实体上的所有组件名称。

method.name: get_id
method.description:
Returns the entity's raw 64-bit id (slot + generation). Stable across worlds, so it can be used for snapshot loading and network replication.
返回实体的原始 64 位 id（槽位 + 代数）。跨世界稳定，可用于快照加载与网络复制。

method.name: getf
method.description:
Convenience sugar for [method get_component].get_field: reads a single field in one call. Returns [code]null[/code] if the component or field does not exist.
[method get_component].get_field 的便捷语法：一次调用读取单个字段。若组件或字段不存在则返回 [code]null[/code]。

method.name: has_component
method.description:
Returns [code]true[/code] if this entity currently has a component of type [param type_name].
若该实体当前拥有 [param type_name] 类型的组件则返回 [code]true[/code]。

method.name: hash_value
method.description:
Returns a stable hash of the entity id, usable as a dictionary key.
返回实体 id 的稳定哈希，可用作字典键。

method.name: is_alive
method.description:
Returns [code]true[/code] if this handle still refers to a live entity in its world.
若该句柄仍指向其世界中的存活实体则返回 [code]true[/code]。

method.name: remove_component
method.description:
Removes the component [param type_name] from this entity, dispatching a REMOVED event. Issuing this inside an iteration is an error; use [method VECSCommandBuffer.remove_component] to defer it.
从该实体移除组件 [param type_name]，并派发 REMOVED 事件。在迭代内调用会报错；请用 [method VECSCommandBuffer.remove_component] 延迟执行。

method.name: setf
method.description:
Convenience sugar for [method get_component].set_field: writes a single field in one call and marks it changed. No-op if the component or field does not exist.
[method get_component].set_field 的便捷语法：一次调用写入单个字段并标记为已变更。若组件或字段不存在则为空操作。
